subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public `before_tool_call` policy-facts contract should OpenClaw expose, and which provenance/session facts are safe for ordinary plugins versus trusted policy plugins?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the durable API shape, taxonomy, redaction rules, and trusted-plugin boundary require maintainer security intent before implementation.

options.title: Unify Policy Facts
options.body: Expose one additive `policyFacts` or equivalent object that covers action/capability classification and redacted provenance consistently across tool paths.

options.title: Narrow Provenance Slice
options.body: Add only the minimum provenance fields needed for CaMeL-style policy plugins and leave action taxonomy to separate capability/classification issues.

options.title: Defer To Security Matrix
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the broader runtime-fact audit model to define the permanent API surface first.

recommendation.title: Unify Policy Facts
recommendation.body: Expose one additive `policyFacts` or equivalent object that covers action/capability classification and redacted provenance consistently across tool paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest identified owner for Plugin SDK hook contract shape and host-hook API evolution.
